annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and exact finite perturbation form of Lemma 3.1 equation (3.2)

assumptions: The truncation threshold, scale beta, and rounding coefficient gammaC are nonnegative.
The low-rank approximation differs from A by truncError with Frobenius norm at most epsilon times beta.
The computed factorized matrix-vector product has a backward perturbation of Frobenius norm at most gammaC times the norm of the low-rank approximation.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P15 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P15 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p15_t2_low_rank_matvec_backward_error {n : Nat} (A Atilde truncError roundingError : P15Matrix n) ... : exists totalError, computed = p15MatVec (A + totalError) v and p15FrobNorm totalError <= gammaC * p15FrobNorm A + epsilon * (1 + gammaC) * beta
formal_statement.plain_language: A low-rank truncation perturbation and the rounded low-rank matrix-vector backward perturbation combine into one perturbation of A with the exact finite radius in equation (3.2).

informal_proof: Choose totalError as truncError plus roundingError. Reassociate the computed matrix action, use the Frobenius triangle inequality twice, bound the norm of Atilde by the norms of A and truncError, and collect the epsilon-gamma cross term.
informal_statement: The exact finite backward-error conclusion of Lemma 3.1, equation (3.2), before replacing the epsilon-gamma product by O(u epsilon).
